2492aa7186ca4f2a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ، ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية، وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة لضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وبتكلفة تقديرية. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارته المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية الإغلاق، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها للأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات متابعة عمليات تطوير الخطط ومراقبة سير العمل. نوع العمل وموقعه هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. نظرة عامة على المسؤوليات يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع مسؤولية ضمان إنجاز المشاريع والبرامج بكفاءة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المحددة. يشمل ذلك متابعة كافة جوانب المشروع من التخطيط والتنفيذ إلى الإغلاق والتقييم، مع التركيز على إدارة المخاطر وتحقيق الأهداف المرجوة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة، يرجى التقديم لهذه الفرصة في إدارة المشاريع.

Familiarity with campaign management platforms, CRM systems, or marketing automation tools. Experience with A/B testing, uplift modeling, next-best-action, offer optimization, or customer lifetime value models. Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms and modern analytics environments. 246218c7df1ee5bc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الوجد العربي عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال وتشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية ومكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية وتشغيل دارات التمديدات الكهربائية. إجراء فحوصات التمديدات الكهربائية، مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض، لضمان سلامتها وكفاءتها. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات اللازمة لمعالجتها بفعالية. متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية للتمديدات الكهربائية لضمان استمرارية عملها. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية المختلفة. معرفة جيدة بأنواع المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الوجد العربي في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل الميداني ومتابعة المشاريع في مواقع مختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

With engineering, innovation, and design activities based in Germany, GROHE products carry the "Made in Germany" quality badge. Role Overview LIXIL is seeking a Project Sales Manager for the Western Region. This employee role is focused on driving profitable sales growth within the market across all channels, aligning with GROHE’s mission. The primary objective is to achieve annual sales targets, increase market share in the project sector, and enhance GROHE's geographical presence within the country. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the overall delivery of country results and organizational leadership. Participate in strategic planning for channel development. Execute the Sales Mission in line with corporate objectives and KPIs. Deliver the Project Channel Sales Mission for the assigned country market, adhering to corporate objectives and KPIs. Manage projects, including writing and maintaining project specifications within the Grohe project system. Align regularly with the Line Manager on mid and long-term strategies for the country, ensuring local implementation complies with corporate guidelines. Provide high-quality information and analysis to support strategic priorities and initiatives. Identify key channels and targets for project business within the region. Forecast accurate project sales on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis. Maintain professional relationships with designers and architects in the country. Develop and maintain a database/records of all key project contacts in the region and prepare reports for senior management. The role involves working within a global brand structure, contributing to market growth and presence in the assigned country. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

24f591ba140b45ba.description: Responsible for managing and executing all customs clearance activities for imports and exports, ensuring full compliance with local regulations while minimizing delays, penalties, and additional costs. Key Responsibilities: Prepare and review all shipping documents (Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin). Coordinate with government authorities (Customs, SFDA, Ports, etc.). Manage end-to-end clearance process from shipment arrival until final release. Ensure correct HS code classification for all shipments. Validate customs duties, taxes, and related charges. Liaise with customs brokers and clearance agents. Handle shipment issues such as inspections, holds, and delays. Monitor critical shipments and reduce clearance lead time. Ensure compliance with all customs regulations and company policies. Provide periodic reports on clearance performance (cost, lead time, issues). Key Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in customs clearance for food manufacturing industry. Strong knowledge of SFDA, customs regulations and systems (e.g., FASAH, SABER). Good understanding of Incoterms. Experience dealing with government entities. Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

243ee34f5be80a72.description: About Tradeics and the Role Tradeics is developing an AI-powered B2B Trade Operating System designed to connect buyers, suppliers, experts, and financiers on a single platform for B2B commerce, procurement, payments, and business services. We are seeking a Sales Manager, Supplier Onboarding Program, to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time role is critical for building and scaling our supplier network, which directly impacts the buyer experience and platform success. Key Responsibilities Design and implement the Supplier Onboarding Program, including defining priority supplier segments and acquisition strategies across various channels (field sales, telesales, digital leads, partnerships, associations, referrals). Build and lead the supplier acquisition team, including designing team structure, hiring specialists, developing onboarding and training programs, setting targets, and managing performance. Engage directly in selling by prospecting, pitching, and activating initial suppliers, and subsequently leading strategic, high-value accounts. Manage the full supplier funnel from initial contact to activation, setting and tracking targets, identifying bottlenecks, and ensuring progression through verification and activation stages. Develop and maintain the Supplier Acquisition Playbook, detailing target profiles, prospecting methods, value propositions, objection handling, closing procedures, and CRM standards. Collaborate with the Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist to align on lead definitions, scoring, response times, and provide feedback on lead quality to optimize marketing spend. Gather and analyze market insights on supplier needs, objections, pricing sensitivity, and adoption barriers, feeding structured information to management, Product, and Marketing teams. Performance Metrics Success in this role will be measured by key indicators including activated suppliers (primary metric), qualified and verified suppliers, lead-to-registration and registration-to-activation conversion rates, time from first contact to activation, specialist productivity, team target achievement, and supplier engagement and retention post-activation. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in sales management or program building. Demonstrated ability to build systems and processes from the ground up. Strong analytical skills with a data-driven approach to performance management. Proven coaching abilities, with a track record of developing team members. Persistence and practicality in sales, capable of handling rejection and closing deals. Comfortable operating in an environment where processes may not yet be fully defined. Compensation and Application Process This role offers competitive compensation with a performance-based component. The hiring process includes an application review, an introductory call, an interview focusing on your track record in team building and deal closing, a practical session involving a live supplier pitch and a 90-day plan presentation, and a final conversation with leadership and reference checks. To apply, please submit your CV through LinkedIn. Include a brief description of a sales team or acquisition program you have built, detailing the number of hires, targets set, and results achieved.

24fa415931f14a20.job_title: Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) Saudi National
24fa415931f14a20.description: About the Role Mace Group is seeking a Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) - Saudi National to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working on one of the largest programs in Saudi Arabia, a major mixed-use development that includes sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Role Overview This is a delivery-focused role responsible for managing contractor performance, construction activities, program milestones, quality standards, and safety objectives across a complex portfolio of works. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with project management, commercial, project controls, and technical teams to ensure successful delivery in line with program, budget, and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead the construction delivery of infrastructure and landscape packages from mobilization through to completion and handover. Manage and oversee main contractors, subcontractors, and site supervision teams. Monitor site progress against program milestones and implement mitigation measures as required. Drive construction productivity and ensure delivery objectives are achieved. Ensure works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements. Coordinate construction activities across multiple stakeholders and disciplines. Oversee the delivery of roads, utilities, drainage, external works, public realm, and landscape elements. Review contractor methodologies, recovery plans, and short-term programs. Manage site risks, constraints, and interface issues to minimize disruption to delivery. Support project controls and commercial teams with progress reporting, change management, and contractual matters. Chair construction progress meetings and coordinate site-based workshops. Monitor compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements at all times. Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, defect resolution, and handover activities. Provide regular reporting on progress, risks, key issues, and mitigation actions. Support operational readiness and transition activities prior to handover. Qualifications and Requirements Demonstrable experience overseeing main contractors on complex developments. Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing, temporary works, and site logistics. Experience managing roads, utilities, drainage, public realm, hardscape, and softscape works. Strong knowledge of health and safety regulations and construction best practice. Experience managing program, quality, risk, and delivery performance. Ability to build effective relationships with contractors, consultants, and stakeholders. Experience within a PMC, client-side, Delivery Partner, or program management environment is preferred. Professional accreditation such as MCIOB, PMP, PE, CEng, or equivalent is advantageous. Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and relevant work experience on high-valued projects/programs for a project management consultancy business, as required for immigration and client approval. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh and involves working on a large-scale mixed-use development project. The position requires close collaboration with various project teams and external stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and encourages applications from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants who may not meet all criteria are still encouraged to apply, as they may be considered for this or other roles within the organization.

24878e6656b73600.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Contract Administrator to join their team in Al Jawf. This full-time position involves the administration and management of assigned construction contracts throughout their lifecycle, from pre-award support to contract closeout. The role requires an Arabic speaker with 8-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Administer assigned construction contracts in accordance with contractual terms, approved procedures, policies, specifications, and applicable laws and regulations. Monitor contractual obligations, milestones, notices, deliverables, key contractual dates, and other requirements throughout the contract lifecycle. Review, prepare, and coordinate contractual correspondence, notices, letters, instructions, and other contract administration documents. Provide contractual advice and recommendations to Project Managers, construction teams, and management regarding contractual rights, obligations, risks, and available actions. Review and process Contract Change Orders/Modifications, including assessment of scope changes, quantities, rates, cost implications, supporting documentation, and time impacts. Coordinate with Engineering, Finance, Planning, Legal, Procurement, and other stakeholders for the review and processing of contractual changes and related submissions. Review and administer Extension of Time requests and related contractual submissions, coordinating with Project Management on delay analysis, critical path, and time impacts. Review contractor claims and contractual submissions, assess contractual entitlement, and provide recommendations for management consideration. Support the administration and resolution of contractual disputes and potential claims, including maintaining relevant contractual records and documentation. Administer contractual procedures related to Final Acceptance, other contractual certificates, final contractual obligations, outstanding claims, warranties, guarantees, final account matters, and completion of required contract records. Coordinate with Project Management, Engineering, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure contractual requirements for acceptance and completion are satisfied. Monitor contractor compliance with contractual obligations and support contractor performance evaluation and related contractual actions. Identify and communicate contractual risks, non-compliance, potential exposure, and outstanding contractual obligations to appropriate management levels. Maintain accurate and complete contract administration records, registers, correspondence, approvals, change history, claims, certifications, and other contractual documentation. Prepare and/or assist in preparing contractual reports, management summaries, presentations, and recommendations relating to assigned contracts. Participate in the selection, training, development, and evaluation of personnel, where assigned. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. About Parsons Corporation Parsons Corporation fosters an innovative culture that values people, embraces agility, and promotes growth, empowering employees to achieve their full potential. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Contract Administrator role are encouraged to apply.

24d816ff1ab81558.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل وصيانة مضخات المياه، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على مضخات إطفاء الحريق، لضمان جاهزيتها وفعاليتها في جميع الأوقات. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة مياه الحريق بشكل دوري وفقاً للجدول الزمني المحدد. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه الكافي، وفتح صمامات المدخل والمخرج لضمان التدفق السليم. ربط خراطيم مياه الإطفاء بمخرج المضخة بطريقة صحيحة وآمنة. تشغيل المضخة بما يتماشى مع خطط العمل المتفق عليها، ومراقبة أدائها بانتظام. تنفيذ برنامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه إطفاء الحريق لضمان استمرارية عملها وكفاءتها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تشغيل وصيانة المضخات، ويفضل أن تكون في مضخات المياه أو أنظمة إطفاء الحريق. القدرة على فهم واتباع جداول الصيانة وخطط العمل. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والإجراءات التشغيلية. بيئة العمل يعمل مشغل مضخة المياه في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل الميداني والتعامل المباشر مع المعدات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

241d4355219f2b95.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors Middle East is dedicated to creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the automotive world forward. The company's vehicles are built on proprietary technology and software-defined architecture, reflecting a "Compromise Nothing™" approach that integrates performance, sustainability, design, and engineering. Lucid achieves this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production managed in-house across global facilities. The LCPA Team Leader Role The LCPA Team Leader is responsible for leading and coordinating the planning, execution, and reporting of Layered Control Process (LCP) Audits across manufacturing operations. This role ensures compliance with standardized work, quality control plans, error-proofing systems, safety requirements, and manufacturing processes. The Team Leader will ensure consistent audit execution, coach team members on audit standards, and drive accountability for process adherence within Lucid Motors Middle East in Saudi Arabia. This is an internship position requiring 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate the planning, scheduling, execution, and reporting of Layered Customer Product Audits (LCPA) across manufacturing, assembly, logistics, and quality operations. Ensure audit coverage is completed according to established schedules and organizational priorities. Coach, mentor, and develop auditors and team members to ensure consistent application of audit standards, methodologies, and reporting requirements. Verify adherence to standardized work instructions, control plans, PFMEA controls, quality standards, and operational procedures. Assess compliance with safety requirements, process controls, product quality standards, and regulatory requirements. Validate the effectiveness of error-proofing (Poka-Yoke) systems, process controls, containment actions, and quality safeguards. Review manufacturing operations for compliance with approved work instructions, process parameters, and operational requirements. Identify high-risk areas through analysis of process deviations, recurring defects, internal audit findings, warranty issues, and customer concerns, adjusting audit focus as needed. Review and approve audit findings, ensuring accurate documentation, objective assessments, and timely communication to stakeholders and leadership. Drive accountability for timely closure of audit findings through effective tracking and verification of corrective and preventive actions. Escalate significant quality, process, safety, or compliance risks to appropriate management levels. Lead follow-up audits and effectiveness reviews to verify the sustainability of implemented corrective actions. Analyze audit performance metrics, trends, and systemic issues to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen process compliance. Support internal quality system audits, customer audits, manufacturing assessments, launch readiness reviews, and operational excellence initiatives. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement actions focused on reducing defects, variation, waste, and process failures. Prepare and present audit performance reports, KPIs, trends, and risk assessments to management and leadership teams. Promote a culture of quality, accountability, process discipline, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. Ensure audit resources are effectively utilized and aligned with business priorities and manufacturing requirements. Support succession planning, capability development, and knowledge sharing within the audit team. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to lead and coordinate audit activities effectively. Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality control plans, and safety requirements. Proficiency in identifying systemic gaps, escalating risks, and facilitating problem-solving. Capability to analyze audit performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities. Work Environment This internship position is based in Saudi Arabia, contributing to Lucid Motors Middle East's manufacturing operations. The role supports manufacturing discipline and operational excellence by identifying systemic gaps, escalating risks, facilitating cross-functional problem-solving, and ensuring timely and effective closure of corrective actions to sustain continuous improvement and product quality.

Collaborate with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. 24b5b92c333afb10.description: About the Role Jacobs is seeking a BIM Manager to join their team in Neom, Al Jawf, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on leading Building Information Modelling (BIM) and digital engineering activities for a major water infrastructure project as it enters its close-out phase. The successful candidate will ensure all BIM models, Civil 3D deliverables, asset information, and digital records accurately reflect completed works and meet handover requirements. Role Context and Focus The BIM Manager will work closely with engineering, construction, GIS, commissioning, and project controls teams. Key areas of focus include as-built model management, data quality assurance, asset information delivery, and the successful transfer of digital project information to the client and operations teams. Key Responsibilities Lead BIM and digital engineering activities for project completion, handover, and close-out. Oversee the development, review, and approval of Civil 3D models, utility networks, corridors, pipe networks, and associated infrastructure deliverables. Coordinate model updates with engineering, construction, GIS, survey, and commissioning teams. Ensure all BIM deliverables meet project standards, client requirements, and information management protocols. Lead the preparation and delivery of digital handover packages, including BIM models, asset information, geospatial data, and as-built records. Establish and implement quality assurance processes for model validation, data integrity, and information completeness. Manage Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows, document control processes, and digital information governance. Support operational readiness and asset management initiatives by ensuring accurate and complete asset information is available for long-term operations and maintenance. Qualifications and Requirements Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in BIM, digital engineering, or design coordination roles supporting major infrastructure, utilities, water, transportation, or civil engineering projects. Technical Knowledge: Strong knowledge of BIM delivery, information management, model coordination, asset information requirements, as-built documentation, and digital project handover processes. Infrastructure Experience: Proven experience delivering BIM for large-scale infrastructure projects, including water, utilities, linear assets, pipeline networks, roads, and civil works. Digital Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM Collaborate Pro, and Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms. Experience with GIS integration and asset information systems is desirable. Project & Commercial Acumen: Experience supporting project delivery, contractor management, digital compliance, handover requirements, change management, risk mitigation, and multidisciplinary coordination. Behavioral Skills: Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to drive digital delivery across multiple project teams. Preferred Experience: Working on major water or utility infrastructure projects in the Middle East, with a strong understanding of BIM standards, ISO 19650 principles, and asset information management requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time onsite position. Employees are expected to attend a Jacobs Workplace on a full-time basis, as required by the nature of the role. About Jacobs Jacobs is committed to fostering a culture of caring and collaboration, connecting employees globally. The company supports flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities for community involvement.
